Brand Introduction:
base bikes is a proudly South Australian company based in the beautiful Adelaide Hills. We specialise in designing and crafting high-quality, lightweight bikes for kids, with a mission to make learning to ride fun, easy, and confidence-building. Inspired by the lack of top-end kids' bike options in Australia, we set out to bring features previously only available overseas to Aussie families.

Product Description:
Our bikes are thoughtfully engineered for children aged 4-10 years, with a focus on safety, performance, and ease of use. Featuring ultra-lightweight frames, child-sized components, and a low centre of gravity, base bikes are perfect for young riders learning to cycle or looking to upgrade to a more advanced bike. Current models include a 16-inch and 20-inch bike in vibrant colours designed to delight both kids and parents.

Unique Selling Points (USPs):

  • Ultra-lightweight design for easy handling and control.
  • No coaster brake—fitted with smooth, child-sized hand brakes for better safety and confidence.
  • Premium-quality materials, including stainless steel spokes, anodised bolts, and durable matt finishes.
  • Low centre of gravity for easier balance and a smoother ride.
  • Proudly tested to Australian safety standards.

Payment Terms:
We offer flexible collaboration terms with influencers, including commission-based affiliate programs or one-time payments for sponsored content. Specific terms can be tailored to your audience and engagement strategy.

Other Information:

  • We’re particularly interested in partnering with influencers who focus on family, parenting, cycling, outdoor activities, or sustainability.
  • Influencers will have access to a unique affiliate code to share with their followers, offering an exclusive incentive while earning commission on sales.
  • We’re excited to collaborate on creative ideas, including content featuring our bikes in action, reviews, or educational tips on teaching kids to ride.
  • Check us out at www.basebikes.com.au for more details!

If you share our passion for creating memorable, active experiences for kids, we’d love to hear from you!

Thanks

Adam

Welcome to the base bikes Affiliate Program!

Thanks for considering our Affiliate Program. These terms and conditions ("Terms") apply to individuals and businesses participating in the base bikes Affiliate Program (the "Program") as a merchant ("we" or "merchant") or an affiliate ("you" or "Affiliate").

By participating in the Program, you agree to use the Program as specified in these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program.

These terms may be updated from time to time.

1. Approval of Registration

We reserve the right to approve, reject, or cancel any Affiliate Program registration in our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection or cancellation of your registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

  • Your Unique Affiliate Link: Upon joining our program, you'll automatically receive a unique affiliate link that you can use to promote our products. You can also generate individual links for specific products or collections, allowing you to tailor your promotions for your audience.
  • How Commissions Are Earned: We use a 'last-click attribution' model to determine commission payouts. This means that if a customer clicks on multiple affiliate links from different affiliates, the last affiliate link they clicked before making a purchase will be credited with the sale. For example, if a customer clicks on Affiliate A's link, then later clicks on your link and makes a purchase, you will receive the commission (as long as the purchase is tracked via our cookies - see our Cookie section below for details).
  • Important Notes:
    • While we encourage the use of any valid coupon codes offered on our site, using a coupon code with an affiliate link will not result in a double commission.
    • If you have a unique, branded coupon code, you are welcome to promote it with your affiliate link. However, please refrain from promoting general coupon codes not specifically assigned to you.
    • You can share your affiliate link and promote our products on various online channels, such as your website, blog, social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, etc.), email newsletters, and online advertising. You are also welcome to utilize offline channels like print advertisements in relevant publications.

3. Commissions and Payment

  • The commission amount is calculated based on the order value, excluding extra fees such as sales tax and shipping costs.
  • To receive your commission payments, please ensure your payment details are updated in your account settings.
  • Commissions are paid only for successfully completed transactions. This means the order has been delivered, and no chargebacks or refunds have been issued.
  • Commissions earned on a sale will be paid out within 60 days of the purchase, typically on a monthly basis.
  • Our Affiliate Program operates under a fair use policy. We reserve the right to review all referral orders to ensure compliance with our Program terms and conditions. Any activity deemed to be in violation of these terms may result in the suspension or termination of your affiliate account.

4. Marketing Tools

  • Promotional media provided is for the exclusive use of promoting base bikes products while you are an active member of our affiliate program. You may resize or crop the media, but no other modifications are permitted. Intellectual property rights are not transferred.

5. Network

  • If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also get a network commission, which depends on merchant settings.
  • To invite other affiliates into the system, share your network link. Any other affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.  

6. Cookies

  • We utilize cookies to track referrals and attribute sales to your affiliate account. When a customer clicks your unique affiliate link, a cookie is placed on their device. This cookie allows us to recognize them as your referral when they make a purchase.
  • Important Note: If a customer disables cookies in their browser settings or clears their cookies, we may not be able to accurately track their purchase, and you may not receive a commission for that sale.
  • The 'cookie duration' is indicated on the Affiliate registration form. This means that a purchase will be associated with your referral for up to the specified number of days from the time the customer clicks your affiliate link.
  • To ensure proper commission attribution, the customer must make the purchase within the cookie duration and using the same device and browser they used to click your link.

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: adam@basebikes.com.au. 

8. Other

If you have any questions, you can contact us at adam@basebikes.com.au for support
